name: Equitable Holdings, Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow finance moat 5/10: an integrated retirement manufacturer + 68%-owned AB asset manager + advisor distribution platform at $1.1-1.2T AUM/A with a leading RILA/variable-annuity franchise and long-duration in-force books — against commodity, fee-competed products with no structural pricing power, GAAP earnings and book value hostage to market-risk-benefit/hedge and AOCI marks (fundamentals.json carries no roic_proxy or gross-margin series for this insurer presentation, and filed ROE is meaningless on AOCI-distorted equity — FY2025 equity was -$74M and Q2 2026 book value per share including AOCI was -$6.79, vs $16.89 ex-AOCI and $30.92 ex-AOCI with AB at market), plus a pending Corebridge merger that will exchange the standalone shares. No evidence supports 7+: returns are earned in a risk business whose bad years are set by markets and biometric experience, not by the franchise.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 7.8%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Investment in capitalized software, leasehold improvements and EDP equipment': $(34) million for FY2025, with $(153) million for FY2024 and $(117) million for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ millions)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
BIG_NET_CASH: net cash is 20.6x normalized OE — part of the price is a cash pile, not the operating business; note it in the verdict
one_liner: Integrated retirement/AB/wealth insurer, moat 5/10 — on the sweep's OCF-based owner's earnings it does not clear 15% (Tier D, weighted IRR 5.44%, IV@15% $12.24 vs $53.21; clears 15% only at ~$12 on this definition), at low confidence: filed OCF is a poor lens for this insurer (non-GAAP operating earnings run far above filed OCF) and the pending Corebridge merger will exchange the standalone shares, so D is a model-misfit verdict, not a clean earnings-power read.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: sector model misfit; tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Integrated retirement value chain — product manufacturer (Equitable), 68%-owned AllianceBernstein asset manager and Equitable Advisors distribution in one group; $1.1T AUM/A at FY2025, $1.2T at Q2 2026
Leading registered index-linked / variable annuity franchise with long-duration in-force books that switch slowly
Scale and advisor distribution that are hard to replicate quickly in U.S. retirement
Persistent capital return — diluted shares shrinking 7.8%/yr on buybacks; Q2 2026 returned $449M to shareholders
moat_against: No structural pricing power — retirement, annuity and asset-management products are price- and fee-competed; AB fees face passive compression
GAAP results hostage to market-risk-benefit and hedge revaluations — FY2025 net loss and Q2 2026 net loss despite positive operating earnings
AOCI-swollen balance sheet — GAAP book value per share was negative at Q2 2026 including AOCI; equity in the filed history fell to -$74M at FY2025
Pending all-stock Corebridge merger (close expected end-2026) — standalone per-share value will be exchanged at 1.55516 new-parent shares, so the DCF is a pre-merger hypothetical
Variable-annuity guarantee and longevity/mortality risk are set by experience, not by the franchise
